evals.prompt: Planning my launch: HN on Monday, Product Hunt Wednesday, Reddit the following week, then a Twitter thread.
evals.expected_output: Should reject the staggered schedule. Trending ranks velocity, Product Hunt is a single day, HN has a ~24h half-life, so spreading is arithmetically close to not promoting. Should collapse everything to one day, HN in the 12:00-17:00 UTC window Tue-Thu. Should run the pre-launch readiness checklist before setting a date.
assertions: Explains velocity-based ranking as the reason
Collapses all channels to a single day
Runs a pre-launch readiness check first

evals.prompt: Should I use the Show HN tag?
evals.expected_output: Should state that the only controlled study (arXiv 2511.04453, n=138) found no significant effect once you control for stage selection: beta = -119.2, SE = 138.3, p = 0.39. Should tag this as measured and note it contradicts near-universal blog advice. Should redirect effort to the predictors that do matter: posting hour, existing stars, and documentation quality.
assertions: States the Show HN tag has no measured effect
Cites the study and the p-value
Redirects to the predictors that do matter
Names posting hour as the actionable one
